title: Cascadia State opens its catalog to AI assistants
summary: Students and families can now connect Claude, ChatGPT, and other assistants directly to official program, course, and service information.

summary: More than four in ten new students are the first in their families to attend college, the highest share in the university's history.

summary: A three-year federal grant funds research on how changing salmon runs affect the region's endangered resident orcas, with paid roles for students.

summary: Environmental science students will spend weekends on the Nisqually watershed, measuring how fish and sediment return after restoration.
